title: Scene Cad Fixture Coordinates
description: elements.scene.fixture/v1 extension data in CAD (Z-up); GLB meshes stay glTF Y-up; runtime maps CAD↔Three.js at render boundary.
summary: Scene fixtures and extension state use CAD Z-up (x right, y front, z up). Runtime converts CAD↔Three.js at the R3F boundary (sketchpad −90° X); GLB meshes stay glTF Y-up without per-mesh rotation. Nakagin fixture rebaked to CAD; relocate/camera report CAD coords. Fixed vitest @elements/framework-react alias.
